title: Senior Medical Director
description:
About Stellar Health

Historically, US Healthcare has relied on a fee-for-service reimbursement system where providers are paid based on the quantity of patient visits and procedures, rather than the quality of health outcomes.

At Stellar Health, we help primary care providers put patient health first. Our platform - a mix of technology, people, and analytics - supports providers at the point of care, delivering real-time patient information, activating practice staff, and empowering providers and care teams with incentives that reward the work they are already doing to keep patients healthy. Using the Stellar App, our web-based, point-of-care tool; practices receive a simple checklist of recommended actions that support the best quality care. Providers and care teams are then paid monthly for each action they complete, and Payors save money in reduced healthcare costs along the way.

Stellar is a US-based Health-tech backed by Top VCs ( General Atlantic, Point72, & Primary Venture Partners) with an established product & proven operating model. We’ve shown that we make a real difference for physician practices and their patients.

About the position

This role will report directly to the VBC Organizational Leader and work across product, operations, risk adjustment, quality and performance management teams. The Senior Medical Director is tasked with clinical management and oversight for Stellar’s MSSP ACO and risk-based payor contracts, inclusive of performance strategy and developing new interventions and levers to improve patient outcomes through Stellar’s Application and Incentive Model.

The Senior Medical Director will also spend ~20% of their time focused on Stellar’s Technology Platform business and supporting Customer and Provider Success Teams in executive engagement with key stakeholders at Payor and Provider entities.

This hire will thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and serve as a clinical leader to operational and product teams to serve as the voice of the provider as we build for success.

What you’ll do

  • Serve as Clinical Leader and advisor to ACO Leadership for strategy, growth, value-based incentive design and performance management
  • Educate and mentor participating providers in value-based care and Stellar-supported performance workflows
  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for provider engagement teams in working with practices to understand and influence clinical workflows and ensuring App adoption to optimize performance
  • Engage Product in roadmap planning/development for optimizing app interventions for provider enablement based on analytics and medical economics findings
  • Be the physician SME for risk adjustment, quality and total cost of care metrics and how to best enable physician engagement
  • Support network development and physician group contracting
  • Support actuary/analytics in Medical Economics analyses (clinical guide)

As Senior Medical Director, you should have

  • Graduate of an accredited medical school MD or DO Degree is required
  • Preferred licensure in one of the following states:
  • IL, MI, MN, NY, PA, WV
  • 3-5 years of full scope clinical practice experience
  • 7+ years in healthcare/clinical leadership in VBC organization is preferred
  • Start-up/tech experience preferred
  • Deep understanding of clinical operations, managed care, value-based contracting and performance
  • Deep experience working with physicians and influencing practice behavior
  • Experience with medical economics and product/intervention development
  • Track record of driving performance in value-based risk contracts
  • Value-based performance strategy and contracting experience
  • Experience/understanding of quality and risk adjustment programs
  • You are an exceptional communicator, and are able to crisply articulate problems and solutions even when operating under uncertainty

Who will love this job

  • Individuals who love the entire journey of problem solving; embracing unstructured problems, developing a path forward, and executing against the plan, and measuring outcomes.
  • Individuals who are curious by nature, and who have a deep desire to learn more about value-based care and about how a healthcare technology startup drives towards success
  • Individuals who enjoy a high degree of autonomy and are unafraid to voice opinions in pursuit of finding a better way of doing things.
  • Individuals who at their core want to be operators – but who also want strategic thinking and medium/long term planning to be a core part of their role.
  • Detail-oriented individuals with the ability to think through complex healthcare problems.
  • You have a deep passion for empowering the goals of value-based care in the primary care environment
  • You care about care delivery and improving patient outcomes
  • You are excited about and have experience building infrastructure from the ground up in a fast-paced environment
  • You get things done and you love working in a dynamic environment

Pay

The salary range for this role is $220,000 - 250,000 + an annual performance based bonus . Where a new hire falls within this range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Stellar\'s bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Stellar rewards performance and outcomes - should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

Perks & Benefits

Stellar offers a carefully curated selection of wellness benefits and perks to our employees:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO
  • Universal Paid Family Leave
  • Company sponsored One Medical memberships and Citibike memberships
  • Medical Travel Benefits
  • A monthly wellness stipend that gives employees the freedom to choose where they spend their cash, whether it be on wellness, pet care, childcare, WFH items, or charitable donations
  • Stock Options & a 401k matching program
  • Career development opportunities like Manager Training, coaching, and an internal mobility program
  • A broad calendar of company sponsored social events that for our in-office and remote employees

Diversity is the key to our success . Stellar Health is an equal opportunity employer and we are open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We believe that diverse teams -and the different identities, cultures, and life experiences our team members bring to the table- enable us to create amazing products, find creative solutions to interesting problems, and build an inclusive working environment.

Stellar Health Employment Privacy Notice

At Stellar Health, your privacy and security as a job seeker is a priority no matter where you are in the interview process . As recruiting scams have become more prevalent, please take note of the following practices to ensure the legitimacy of any interaction with our team.

  • Please note that any communication from our recruiters and hiring managers at Stellar Health about a job opportunity will only be made by a Stellar Health employee with an @stellar.health email address.
  • Stellar Health does not utilize third-party agencies for recruitment services and does not conduct text message or chat-based interviews. Any other email addresses, agencies, or forums may be phishing scams designed to obtain your personal information.
  • We will not ask you to provide personal or financial information, including, but not limited to, your social security number, online account passwords, credit card numbers, passport information, and other related banking information until we begin onboarding activities, which will be coordinated by a member of the Stellar Health People Ops Team with an @stellar.health email address.

If you are ever unsure whether you are in contact with a legitimate Stellar Health teammate, please contact If you believe you\'ve been a victim of a phishing attack, please mark the communication as “spam” and immediately report it by contacting the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

description:
Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD

Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD role at Trilogy.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$200.00/hr - $200.00/hr

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult for more details on this topic.

title: Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions)
description:
Overview

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. Lilly Catalyze360, a Division of Lilly Research Laboratories, is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem, agnostic of the therapeutic area. There are four pillars: Lilly Gateway Labs, ExploR&D, Lilly Ventures and Lilly TuneLab. Learn more about Catalyze360 at:

Lilly Gateway Labs links Lilly to an entrepreneurial community fostering innovation. It provides biotech companies direct access to Lilly scientists and expertise, opportunities to collaborate on projects of mutual interest, and learning forums with Lilly experts and partners, with potential for financial investment from Lilly or venture funds. Learn more at:

ExploR&D is a drug development organization within Catalyze360 focused on catalyzing the biotechnology ecosystem. It advances investigational medicines for external sponsors with speed and efficiency and supports programs across North America, Europe, and Asia. Learn more at:

Lilly Ventures maintains relationships with life science-focused funds to gain access to emerging science, with three portfolios (Therapeutics, Technology, and Impact) and investment tools including fund partnerships and direct investments.

Lilly TuneLab provides access to AI/ML tools leveraging Lilly's drug discovery models.

Position

The successful candidate for the Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions) will be a core member of Lilly’s legal team, helping drive the company’s mission and serving as a trusted advisor and leader to the Catalyze360 team. The role offers the opportunity to contribute immediately to Lilly’s growth and success. We seek a proven leader who is motivated, proactive, thrives in ambiguity, self-starting, and enjoys challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

This position provides legal support for the Lilly Gateway Labs and ExploR&D capabilities of Catalyze360 and will have the following responsibilities:

  • Lead the structuring, drafting, negotiating and counseling on transactions (including licenses and collaborations, R&D services, equity investments, divestitures and other transactions).
  • Serve as both a legal and business partner in structuring and implementing new Catalyze360 offerings and transaction models.
  • Develop agreement templates and playbooks and lead training for the Catalyze360 team.
  • Identify and resolve critical legal and business issues throughout the lifecycle of Catalyze360 agreements, including post-transaction alliance management support.
  • Partner with the Catalyze360 team and other internal stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and support the growth of the Catalyze360 organization.
  • Exercise excellent judgment to influence and drive decision-making.
  • Cultivate and contribute to the development of a high-performance transactions legal team and a collaborative culture with colleagues in the legal department and other key functions.
  • Demonstrate a service-oriented approach to advising internal client groups.
  • Serve as a recognized source of innovative ideas in complex areas of law, business, or technology with respect to transactional matters.

Basic Requirements

  • J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Admitted to the bar in at least one state.
  • Minimum of six (6) years of legal experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating sophisticated transactions in either a law firm or in-house, or a combination of both.
  • Significant experience drafting and negotiating complex transaction agreements in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry (including CRO and CDMO agreements).
  • Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not sponsor work authorization or visas for this role.

Additional Skills/Preferences

  • Ability to proactively identify opportunities for creative and innovative solutions to transactional issues and process improvements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and business judgment with the ability to influence others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to manage internal client expectations and collaborate in cross-functional teams within a matrix environment.
  • Professional demeanor with the gravitas to lead and influence a seasoned business team.
  • Fast, nimble, and able to pivot between audiences to provide timely legal and business advice.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative, and capable of working independently.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects with priorities and deadlines.
  • Analytical and strategic with the ability to devise creative solutions to drive toward recommendations and closure.
  • Impeccable integrity and ability to handle confidential matters with discretion.
  • Ability to lead outside counsel selection and oversee legal costs.

description:
Visão Geral

Título da Vaga: Product Manager (Gestão de Produto)

Atuação: Remoto

Sobre a Previdas:

A Previdas conecta advogados e clientes a médicos especialistas por meio da telemedicina, com foco em medicina legal e perícia médica.

Nosso objetivo é transformar a relação entre o jurídico e o médico, oferecendo serviços compatíveis com demandas jurídicas, com previsibilidade, confiança e estrutura para escritórios de advocacia em todo o Brasil. Estamos em expansão e construindo uma base sólida de produto, tecnologia e operação, para escalar com eficiência e propósito.

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Gerente de Produto (Product Manager) para liderar o desenvolvimento do nosso principal produto digital, a plataforma que conecta advogados e médicos em fluxos inteligentes de telemedicina e gestão jurídica.

Nesta posição, você será responsável por traduzir a visão da empresa em estratégia de produto, conectar as necessidades dos usuários à execução técnica e guiar o time no que realmente gera valor.

Procuramos alguém com mentalidade analítica, empatia pelo usuário, clareza estratégica e alguém que entenda tanto o negócio quanto o impacto real de cada decisão no produto.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir, comunicar e evoluir a visão e o roadmap de produto, alinhando objetivos de negócio, tecnologia e experiência do usuário.
  • Conduzir descobertas de produto (product discovery) com advogados, médicos e stakeholders, para identificar oportunidades reais de valor.
  • Priorizar demandas com base em impacto e esforço, mantendo o equilíbrio entre entregas rápidas e evolução de longo prazo.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia e Design para garantir clareza técnica e excelência na execução.
  • Acompanhar e analisar métricas de produto (retenção, engajamento, NPS, taxa de sucesso dos fluxos), propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Estruturar e comunicar decisões de forma clara e colaborativa, promovendo alinhamento entre as áreas.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura de produto dentro da empresa, com foco em aprendizado e autonomia.

Qualificações Essenciais

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Manager ou função equivalente, atuando com produtos digitais.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de produto com clareza e foco.
  • Experiência em definição de roadmap, priorização de backlog e acompanhamento de ciclo de vida de produto.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Lean).
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de transitar entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Perfil analítico, com familiaridade em métricas de produto e raciocínio orientado a dados.
  • Proatividade e autonomia.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em healthtechs, lawtechs ou empresas similares.
  • Experiência em telemedicina, dados, SaaS ou integrações com APIs de pagamento (Asaas, Stripe, etc).

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de comportamento e produto (Amplitude, Hotjar, Mixpanel, GA4).
  • Background técnico ou experiência próxima com times de engenharia.

Por que se juntar à Previdas?

Impacto direto: Seu trabalho moldará a principal plataforma de uma empresa em rápido crescimento.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Overview

Omada Health is on a mission to inspire and engage people in lifelong health, one step at a time.

Job overview: As the Director, Product Design, you will be a pivotal leader within the product organization, responsible for driving our long-term design strategy and cultivating a world-class team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will manage the product design team partnering with brand, product, engineering and clinical to ensure a consistent, intuitive, and high-quality experience for both consumers and care team members. Your role will involve collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, engineering, and marketing to align design efforts with broader business objectives. You will spearhead the development of scalable, repeatable design systems and guidelines, while your leadership will emphasize user-centered design, innovation, and compliance. With a focus on personalization for key member segments at various stages of their health journeys, you will ensure that our products drive higher engagement, retention, and outcomes. Your strategic leadership, impeccable design eye, and user-centric approach will be instrumental in guiding the UI/UX vision and its execution across all touchpoints, ultimately achieving measurable impacts on member delight and business success.

Applicants should submit a portfolio showcasing a proven track record in creating consumer-focused UX that solves complex design problems providing impact to customers and the business, ideally within a healthcare category.

Your Impact

  • Team Development and Mentorship: Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development for the product design team to maximize their impact and professional growth.
  • Design Excellence and Learning Culture: Champion best-in-class design practices and foster a culture of continuous learning to elevate design excellence.
  • User Experience and Interface Design: Oversee the development of user-centered design processes, including research and testing, and ensure consistent, appealing UI designs across platforms.
  • Design System: Develop and maintain a scalable design system.
  • Innovation: Encourage innovation through AI and emerging technologies to enhance the design process.
  • Strategic Hiring and Organizational Scaling: Implement strategic hiring practices, effective onboarding processes, and develop a robust organizational design to scale the design team.
  • Vision and Strategy Articulation: Craft and communicate a design strategy that aligns with product and business objectives, while also advocating for the role of design at the executive level
  • Strategic Decision-Making and Leadership: Apply strategic leadership and problem-solving skills to navigate complex challenges and align design efforts with long-term company goals.
  • Clear Expectations and Accountability: Set clear goals, roles, and responsibilities, and establish rhythms of accountability to maintain performance standards and a healthy team culture.
  • Collaboration and Influence: Lead cross-functional collaboration, leveraging influence and communication skills to drive change and align with company values across different departments.
  • Customer Insights: Partner with the user research and clinical teams to gather insights that inform design decisions (research is a partner, not a director report).
  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with accessibility standards and relevant regulations.

About you

  • A Bachelor’s degree in user experience, design, or other related field
  • You have 10+ years of experience in product design, turning complex problems into engaging design solutions
  • You have at least 5 years of experience managing and scaling teams larger than 5 ICs including principal and staff level designers, with a track record of scaling and developing high-performing teams.
  • You have a deep understanding of user-centered design processes and consumer-focused digital experiences
  • You have direct experience driving strategic business outcomes through design of apps, ideally within the health category
  • You possess exceptional strategic thinking and execution skills, capable of translating high-level vision into tactical plans while maintaining a focus on detail.
  • You are a seasoned leader with a strong ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • You are a proactive problem-solver with the ability to navigate complex cross functional challenges and drive clarity in ambiguous situations
  • Appreciation of standards; proven methods and tools to enforce brand identity and consistency across all projects
  • An ability to prioritize work in a fast paced environment and meet changing deadlines and priorities on multiple simultaneous projects
  • Demonstrated expertise in integrating AI, ML, or automation both in design workflows and shipped product experiences.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health

Omada Health is a between-visit healthcare provider that addresses lifestyle and behavior change elements for individuals managing chronic conditions. Omada’s multi-condition platform treats diabetes, hypertension, prediabetes, musculoskeletal, and GLP-1 management. With insights from connected devices and AI-supported tools, Omada care teams deliver care that is rooted in evidence and unique to every member, unlocking results at scale. With more than a decade of experience and data, and 29 peer-reviewed publications showcasing clinical and economic proof points, Omada’s approach is designed to improve health outcomes and contain costs. Our customers include health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, health systems, and employers ranging from small businesses to Fortune 500s. At Omada, we aim to inspire and empower people to make lasting health changes on their own terms. For more information, visit: omadahealth.com

title: Enterprise architect specialist
description:
Overview da Oportunidade

Empresa com +15 anos de experiência desenvolvendo software em 4 continentes, com sedes no Brasil e EUA. Descreve atuação em desenvolvimento de soluções digitais (web, mobile, BI, RPA, entre outros).

Remoto | 44h semanais

Para você nos conhecer melhor: Desenvolvemos pessoas, softwares & negócios.

Essa posição envolve liderar e apoiar atividades estratégicas e holísticas relacionadas à definição, desenvolvimento e gestão de padrões de modelagem e arquitetura corporativa.

  • Arquiteto Corporativo Especialista com foco em liderar e apoiar atividades estratégicas relacionadas à definição, desenvolvimento e gestão de padrões de modelagem e arquitetura corporativa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Atuar como líder na implementação e manutenção de uma arquitetura corporativa integrada, alinhando-a com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de negócios e técnicas, promovendo sinergia e garantindo que os requisitos técnicos sejam incorporados nas soluções.
  • Apoiar o time de negócios no desenvolvimento de uma visão técnica robusta, facilitando a comunicação entre áreas e orientando na criação de representações técnicas (como o modelo C4).
  • Estabelecer e gerenciar padrões de modelagem para assegurar consistência e eficiência no desenvolvimento de soluções corporativas.
  • Identificar oportunidades para otimizar processos e soluções existentes, orientando a organização para a inovação e sustentabilidade tecnológica.
  • Estruturar e manter direcionadores estratégicos da Arquitetura Corporativa (Princípios, Metas e Objetivos estratégicos, Capacidades por produto).
  • Definir padrões de estudos para análise e desenvolvimento de soluções corporativas e atuar como guardião da aplicação desses padrões nas entregas da equipe.
  • Zelar pela padronização de roadmaps por superintendência, assegurando alinhamento estratégico e operacional.
  • Criar e manter roadmaps estratégicos que detalhem a evolução do portfólio de soluções corporativas, definindo transições do estado atual para o futuro, conforme a arquitetura de soluções.
  • Desenvolver entregáveis como padrões de estudos, roadmap evolutivo, mapa de capacidades com análise de calor e insights para novos estudos com base em deficiências ou necessidades de evolução.
  • Revisar e propor o Comitê e Fóruns de Negócios estratégicos.

Habilidades que Você Precisa Ter

  • Faculdade em área de TI (Ciências da Computação, Processamento de Dados, Análise de Sistemas, Inteligência Artificial, Business Analytics, Transformação Digital, outros relacionados).
  • Especialização ou pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas à TI.
  • Experiência em Arquitetura Corporativa.
  • Experiência com modelagem de Arquitetura em soluções como Archimate, LeanIX, Hopex ou similares, e participação e influência no processo de implementação de arquitetura corporativa.
  • Bom entendimento de gerenciamento de produtos, princípios ágeis e metodologias de desenvolvimento, com capacidade de apoiar equipes ágeis, orientando sobre oportunidades, impactos e riscos.
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas, de planejamento, organizacionais e técnicas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com desenvolvedores em ambiente terceirizado.
  • Experiência em navegação por políticas organizacionais e habilidade de influenciar stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de articular novas ideias para públicos técnicos e não técnicos, compreender perspectivas de longo e curto prazo, traduzir requisitos de negócio em requisitos de arquitetura, e estimar impactos financeiros de alternativas de solução.
  • Trazer curiosidade intelectual, integridade, comprometimento com resultados de longo prazo e habilidade de trabalhar bem em equipe.

Habilidades que vão fazer você se Destacar

  • Experiência com SAP LeanIX.
  • Certificações em Scrum, PMP e/ou TOGAF.

O que Você Vai Encontrar na GX2

  • Hub de conteúdo autoral segmentado por trilhas de conhecimento (IA, QA, Agilidade, Design UX/UI, Produto, Desenvolvimento de Software).
  • Talks mensais focados no desenvolvimento de soft skills.
  • Cultura de cuidado com as pessoas e saúde mental.
  • Plataforma de saúde mental e bem-estar.
  • Follow Up GX2: acompanhamento mensal individual voltado ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento.

Recado da GX2

Esta é uma vaga abrangente a todas as pessoas interessadas. Trabalhamos diariamente para construir um ambiente diverso e plural, que valoriza e respeita as diferenças e defendemos a liberdade de ser quem se é, livre de estereótipos e preconceitos.

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Director - Revenue Cycle Continuous Improvement
description:
Overview

Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.

Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and direct comprehensive revenue cycle-wide processes, including but not limited to denials & write-off prevention, vendor management, data insights, and systems applications support teams.
  • Provide strategic analysis and interpretation of critical revenue cycle data, identifying process improvement opportunities and monitoring performance against targets.
  • Conduct risk assessments to achieve KPI targets, report identified risks to senior management and provide strategic recommendations for mitigation.
  • Lead the coordination with operational leaders, managed care, vendor management, and other stakeholders to development of action plans aimed at achieving top decile metric performance.
  • Oversee the development and management of A/R and performance improvement issues logs, quantifying the impact of improvement initiatives, and prioritizing solutions within a functional area.
  • Provide operational leaders with strategic data and insights to drive targeted actions for metric improvement.
  • Develop and present comprehensive status reports and action-oriented summaries for executive leaders across the system.
  • Actively participate and co-lead metric and project calls with senior management and support staff.
  • Create and deliver high-quality presentations and updates for senior leaders across the health system.
  • Act as a liaison between data analytics and functional experts across the revenue cycle and health system to identify and drive forward measurable performance improvement.
  • Develop, recommend, and oversee the implementation and administration of policies and procedures. Evaluate processes and procedures and coordinate with the management team to ensure areas of focus adhere to federal and local laws and regulations.
  • Coordinate with IT to ensure continuous data availability and file needs.

Required Skills

  • Proven analytical and critical thinking skills required to synthesize complex data sets and interpret qualitative and quantitative data and trends to implement recommendations resulting in measurable performance improvement and successful organizational change.
  • Exceptional ability to create and deliver impactful presentations, tailoring messages for a variety of leaders and roles with the system.
  • Proven capability to manage complex multi-workstream performance improvement projects while delegating and overseeing the work of junior team members.
  • Impactful and professional written and verbal communication to set clear project team direction, develop key deliverables, escalate risks, and influence key stakeholders inclusive of client and internal senior leadership.
  • Advanced knowledge of revenue cycle functions and payer denials with the ability to collaborate with team members and counterparts to understand business challenges, adapt implementation methodologies to ensure alignment with the client’s business objectives.
  • Extensive experience in building talent, training, supervising, coaching/mentoring, and performance management.

Core Qualifications

  • Current permanent U.S. work authorization required.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Limited travel required.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Extensive leadership experience.
  • 8-10 years of healthcare operations leadership and/or consulting experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Relevant healthcare revenue cycle experience directing a department and/or team-based projects with a focus on performance improvement initiatives and change management, OR
  • Project leadership and workplan management experience within a consulting firm setting with a focus on hospital or physician revenue cycle, and denials management.
  • Experience managing both onshore and offshore staff.

Candidate Qualities

  • Advanced knowledge of revenue cycle processes.
  • Strong understanding of revenue cycle metrics and the levers that drive them in the patient access, patient financial services, and HIM/coding environment.
  • Ability to design and apply conceptual models to business problems to understand issues and support with reporting and analytics.
  • Effective and efficient organization and planning skills with the proven ability to manage complex multi-workstream performance improvement projects, while delegating and overseeing the work of junior team members.
  • Proven analytical and critical thinking skills required to synthesize complex data sets and interpret qualitative and quantitative data and trends to implement recommendations resulting in measurable performance improvement and successful organizational change.
  • Impactful and professional written and verbal communication to set clear project team direction, develop key deliverables, escalate risks, and influence key stakeholders inclusive of client and internal senior leadership.
  • Ability to collaborate with team members and client counterparts to understand business challenges, adapt implementation methodologies and approaches to ensure results align with the client’s business objectives.
  • Team leadership experience including building talent, training, supervising, coaching/mentoring, and performance management.

Compensation and Benefits

The estimated salary range for this job is $130,000 - $170,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy and Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
Title: Chief Financial Officer

Location: Remote

About The Princeton Review

The Princeton Review (TPR) is a leading tutoring, test prep, and college admission services company. Every year, it helps millions of college- and graduate school–bound students achieve their education and career goals through online and in-person courses delivered by a network of more than 4,000 teachers and tutors, online resources, and its more than 150 print and digital books published by Penguin Random House. The company’s Tutor.com brand is one of the largest online tutoring services in the U.S. It comprises a community of thousands of tutors who have delivered more than 28 million one-to-one tutoring sessions. The Princeton Review is headquartered in New York, NY. Follow the company on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram.

About the Position

We’re seeking a strategic and results-driven Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead The Princeton Review and Tutor.com’s financial strategy, planning, and business operations. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the CFO will be a key member of the executive leadership team, responsible for shaping the financial future of the organization and ensuring fiscal discipline across all business units.

The CFO will oversee all aspects of financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, treasury, and compliance. This role will also oversee business operations including corporate real estate and supply chain. This role requires a visionary leader who can align financial strategy with organizational goals, drive operational efficiency, and support sustainable growth. The CFO will work closely with senior leaders across departments to provide data-driven insights, guide investment decisions, and ensure the company maintains a strong financial foundation to serve its diverse student populations.

This is a pivotal role with significant impact on the company’s performance, requiring a blend of strategic foresight, operational excellence, and collaborative leadership.

What You\'ll Do

As Chief Financial Officer, you will lead the financial strategy and operations of The Princeton Review and Tutor.com, ensuring the organization’s fiscal health and supporting its long-term growth. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Strategic Financial Leadership: Develop and execute financial strategies that align with the company’s mission, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Financial Planning & Analysis: Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes to ensure financial sustainability and performance.
  • Reporting & Compliance: Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, compliance with regulatory requirements, and successful completion of audits.
  • Treasury & Capital Management: Manage cash flow, banking relationships, and capital allocation to optimize financial resources and support strategic investments.
  • Executive Collaboration: Partner with the CEO and executive team to provide financial insights and support data-driven decision-making across departments.
  • Operational Oversight: Lead business operations including corporate real estate and supply chain, driving efficiency and cost-effectiveness across the enterprise.
  • Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Technology & Systems: Oversee financial systems and tools, driving automation and scalability to support a growing and dynamic organization.

Who You Are

  • A seasoned financial executive with 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in corporate finance, and ideally within multi-unit or service-based organizations.
  • The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in financial planning and analysis, accounting, treasury, and compliance, with a proven track record driving strategic growth and operational efficiency.

  • Experience working with behavioral health population

  • Leadership, collaboration, and motivational skills
  • Ability to multi task and perform in a fast paced, and often intense environment

description:
Overview

SOBRE A BUZZCREATORS
A Buzzcreators é uma plataforma brasileira especializada em conectar marcas com influenciadores, especialmente micro e nano influenciadores, para a criação e gestão de campanhas de marketing de influência. Ela oferece uma solução automatizada e baseada em dados para facilitar todo o processo, desde o planejamento até a execução e pagamento das campanhas.

Vaga - 100% HOME OFFICE

O que buscamos

O SDR em vendas (Sales Development Representative, ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas) terá a responsabilidade de identificar e qualificar leads, estabelecer contatos, criar oportunidades de negócio e auxiliar os times comerciais. Além disso, atuará na etapa pré-vendas, com habilidades específicas, antes de as vendas começarem.

Atividades

  • Prospecção ativa 100% focada em Outbound de empresas e agências interessadas e com potencial para se tornarem clientes Buzzmonitor;
  • Compreensão das necessidades/dores de negócio do cliente;
  • Apresentação de plataforma para solucionar essas necessidades;
  • Mapeamento de necessidades e potenciais projetos.

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou completo;
  • Experiência na posição de SDR/Inside Sales;
  • Experiência com metodologia de venda BANT;
  • Experiência com Google Docs ou Microsoft Office;
  • Experiência com processo outbound;
  • Experiência com criação de listas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Técnica de vendas: Spin Selling;
  • Prospecção ABM;
  • Experiência no setor de Marketing Digital;
  • Experiência com Atendimento (SAC 4.0);
  • Experiência com tecnologia ou software SaaS;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de captação de cliente e validação de email (Sales Engagement).

title: Senior Solution Architect - Customer Success (Brazil)
description:
Overview

Senior Solution Architect - Customer Success (Brazil) at Articul8 AI. You will shape GenAI-based solutions, working with customers' technical and business leaders to understand gaps and objectives, and craft scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures.

About us

At Articul8 AI, we relentlessly pursue excellence and create exceptional AI products that exceed customer expectations. We are a team of dedicated individuals who take pride in our work and strive for greatness in every aspect of our business. We believe in using our advantages to make a positive impact on the world and inspiring others to do the same.

Job Description

Articul8 AI is seeking an exceptional Solution Architect to join us in shaping the future of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI). You will work within the Product Technology team with customers’ technical and business leaders to understand their technical gaps, needs, and business objectives. You will craft GenAI-based solutions that promote innovation and accelerate bringing new products to market. This role offers opportunities to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to drive enterprise-grade GenAI innovations.

Responsibilities

  • Solution Design: Develop detailed, scalable architectural designs addressing client needs using Articul8 products and third-party tools.
  • Piloting and Prototyping: Run pilot programs with customers to demonstrate feasibility and advantages; introduce new features or build prototypes as needed.
  • Client Interaction: Engage with clients through workshops, meetings, and presentations to communicate solutions and best practices.
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize for performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness; select instance types, auto-scaling configurations, and storage options.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure solutions meet security best practices and regulatory requirements; implement IAM, data encryption, and related measures.
  • Documentation and Training: Create comprehensive architecture documentation and provide training to clients or internal teams.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate with Applied Research, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Customer Success to maintain product technology leadership.
  • Leadership: Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of rapid innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience: 2+ years in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructure; 4+ years in technology domains such as software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics.
  • Education: BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technology stack: Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); Languages (Python, Node.js, Go, Ruby); APIs/Integration (OpenAPI, FastAPI, Swagger, Flask, REST); Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis); ML Frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Keras); Development/Deployment (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes); Monitoring/Logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK); Version Control (Git, GitHub, GitLab); Architecture Design/Modeling (Microsoft Visio, Drawio); Collaboration/Project Management (JIRA, Confluence, Trello).
  • Education: Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or related fields preferred.
  • Experience developing tools, libraries, and infrastructure for data preprocessing, model training/finetuning, and deployment of LLMs in research and production environments.

Professional Attributes

  • Problem Solving: Breaks down complex problems into manageable components and devises creative solutions with iterative refinement.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Works effectively in cross-functional teams, communicates clearly, and respects diverse perspectives.
  • Project Management and Prioritization: Balances multiple projects, sets milestones, and monitors progress; allocates time efficiently between short- and long-term goals.
  • Critical Thinking: Evaluates assumptions, questions methodologies, and remains skeptical when interpreting results.
  • Curiosity and Continuous Learning: Maintains a proactive approach to learning and staying updated on related fields.
  • Emotional Intelligence and Intellectual Humility: Demonstrates empathy, resilience, adaptability, self-awareness, and collaboration.

Perks and Benefits

Competitive salary and benefits package, along with:

  • Professional development opportunities, including training and mentorship programs
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote options
  • Access to the latest technologies and tools
  • Regular social events and team-building activities
  • A supportive and inclusive work environment

Note: This position is available via CLT contract only.

title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Overview

Job Title : Agency Care Specialist

Location : Remote/Nationwide, USA

Additional Location(s)

Employee Type : Employee

Working Hours Per Week : 40

Job Description

AtCSI Pharmacy (CSI) , we are on a mission to provide Specialty Pharmacy services to patients with chronic and rare illnesses in need of complex care. CSI is a rapidly growing national Specialty Pharmacy. Whether you work directly with patients or behind the scenes in support of the business and its employees, you will use your expertise, experience, and skills to support our patients and our mission.

Pay Range : $52,000 - $72,000/yr (DOE)

Schedule : (Remote) Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm CST

Location : Ideally residing in a CST state since the schedule is CST; however, not a requirement

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a point of contact for patients and agency nurses, responding promptly to inquiries and coordinating care needs.
  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Nurse Supervisor and Agency Intake Liaison to support onboarding, compliance tracking, and agency service coordination.
  • Accurately process patient orders, clinical documentation, and prescription labels, ensuring timely and organized recordkeeping.
  • Escalate clinical concerns or changes in patient condition to the Clinical Nurse Supervisor or appropriate team member.
  • Coordinate nursing schedules and verify patient information in collaboration with pharmacy and nursing teams.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of all patient interactions, including urgent requests, complaints, and service issues.
  • Identify and report compliance issues, scheduling conflicts, and patient-reported concerns to the Clinical Nurse Supervisor for appropriate follow-up.
  • Support administrative tasks such as scanning, organizing records, and preparing scheduling materials.
  • Participate in special assignments, including contacting agencies for missing documentation or lab due dates.
  • Uphold professional conduct and represent the organization positively in all interactions.
  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and compliance standards.

  • At least 1 year of customer service experience

  • Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

  • Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions.

  • Teamwork - Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit.
  • Business Acumen - Conserves organizational resources.
  • Diversity - Demonstrates knowledge of EEOC policy; Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.
  • Ethics - Treats people with respect; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.
  • Planning/Organizing - Uses time efficiently.
  • Professionalism - Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration, regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.
  • Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
  • Observes safety and security procedures; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and materials properly.
  • Adaptability - Able to handle frequent changes, delays, or unexpected events.
  • Attendance/Punctuality - Is consistently at work and on time.
  • Dependability - Follows instructions and responds to management\'s directions.
  • Initiative - Asks for and offers help when needed

The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

title: Sr. Loan Workout Relationship Manager
description:
Overview

Location: 127 Public Square, Cleveland Ohio

ABOUT THE JOB
The Sr. Loan Workout Relationship Manager is the most senior level specialized account manager position. This position is responsible for managing a portfolio of accounts with high levels of complexity and will lead all workout activity for assigned accounts. Individuals at this level are fully experienced, qualified workout professionals capable of independently managing large and complex accounts, including highly structured lending arrangements and Agented or Participant loan facilities.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a loan portfolio to mitigate risk with deals consisting of multiple loan types offered by Key Bank and with unlimited complexity and potential for adversarial litigation. Relationships will include accounts with aggregate balances generally above $25MM.
  • Review and analyze loan documentation, financial statements and other similar loan and borrower information to assess risk, quantify repayment capacity, consider the adequacy of repayment sources and/or estimate recovery potential.
  • Develop, recommend and implement workout/liquidation strategies for problem loans including past due, underperforming, non-performing, and charged-off loans to mitigate risk and maximize recovery.
  • Exercise individual delegated approval authority or recommend to higher level approval authority for modifications, payment deferrals, or other actions to resolve assigned accounts
  • Adhere to department and corporate guidelines, policies and compliance procedures.
  • Maintain constructive interaction with clients, work colleagues, lines of business and bank regulators.
  • Work with other professionals such as appraisers, environmental consultants, auctioneers, real estate brokers and property managers to maximize return on collateral secured loans.
  • Work with bank counsel in a cost-effective manner to achieve desired results.
  • Support departmental continuous improvement efforts.
  • Periodically travel to meet with clients or view collateral.
  • Participate in the Quarterly Asset Quality Review process and produce timely documentation as required.
  • Shadow accounts on the line of business which need workout advice.
  • Manage and recommend commercial assets for non-accrual or charge-off disposition as appropriate.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all KeyBank policies and procedures.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Business, Finance, or Economics preferred).
  • Min.10 years commercial credit experience (e.g. underwriting, credit risk management, workout, commercial banker)
  • Demonstrated experience in commercial loan workouts
  • Demonstrated regulatory knowledge, understanding and ability to apply accounting, banking laws, required rules and regulations, credit policy, and risk-rating requirements necessary.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct in-depth financial statement analysis required.
  • Demonstrated leadership ability.
  • Demonstrated strong organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet multiple deadlines and manage a variety of projects with deliverables.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and focus on implementing solutions.
  • Ability to quantify risks and perform objective analyses.
  • Ability to work independently and in teams to resolve issues and solve problems.
  • Competent in standard office productivity programs (MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred locations for this role are Cleveland, Albany, Buffalo, or Denver. Strong remote candidates based in other U.S. locations may be considered.

Compensation and Benefits

This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $112,000 to $150,000 annually depending on location and job-related factors such as level of experience. Compensation for this role also includes eligibility for short-term incentive compensation and deferred incentive compensation subject to individual and company performance.

Transformando mercados com tecnologia há mais de 30 anos. Nós impactamos vidas através da Tecnologia.

Além da engenharia, buscamos alguém com perfil de evangelização técnica — capaz de documentar entregas e descobertas, apresentar resultados em fóruns internos e externos, compartilhar boas práticas e contribuir para disseminar uma cultura de IA ética, segura e orientada a impacto.

Você fará parte da equipe que está construindo uma das arquiteturas de IA mais avançadas já aplicadas ao sistema de Justiça .

O projeto combina múltiplas camadas tecnológicas, vetorização semântica, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), multi-LLMs e pipelines distribuídos, para compreender grandes volumes de dados jurídicos de forma segura e explicável.

O impacto vai além da tecnologia: cada decisão apoiada pela nossa IA pode representar mais eficiência, menos morosidade e mais acesso à Justiça para a sociedade.

  • Contribuir com o desenho e evolução da arquitetura distribuída (multi-workers/processors) conectada a sistemas judiciais e múltiplos LLMs.
  • Conhecimento em estatística, probabilidade e algoritmos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clusterização etc.).

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)

You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'ll juggle help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line interfaces; Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
