  • Data Governance: Ensure consistent usage of concepts, metrics, and KPI definitions across data products.
  • Quality Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability in dashboards by proactively detecting data deviations and resolving them with Analytics Engineers. Develop new quality tests for new data products.
  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Work with the Global Analytics team to ensure a robust data product ecosystem and consistent reporting methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Relationship: Collaborate with Insights Managers and business stakeholders to understand needs and ensure analytics deliverables align with objectives.
  • Live the Mission: Inspire and empower others by caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work and foster a supportive environment for self-care, time off, and work-life wellness.

Who You Are

  • Resides in Brazil.
  • Degree in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related fields.
  • Previous experience with Marketing Analytics, BI or Data Science.
  • Proficiency in BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Amplitude).
  • Advanced knowledge in SQL and/or Python for data analysis and exploration.
  • Preferred knowledge of marketing technology platforms such as Hubspot, SFMC, Braze, or Segment.
  • Understanding of marketing concepts and user journeys.
  • Strong storytelling and data presentation skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We encourage all aspiring applicants to apply, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. For this role, prior experience with Tableau, Metabase, Python or SQL and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

What We Offer

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to own your role and wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of life. Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize benefits according to your needs.

Our Benefits Include

  • WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more. You can add up to three family members.
  • WELLZ: An emotional wellbeing program with personalized journeys, including 52 individual therapy sessions per year and on-demand content.
  • HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: Hybrid and remote options; home office reimbursement; model discussed with recruiter and hiring manager.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Schedules defined with leaders to align with time zones and personal routines.
  • PAID TIME OFF: Vacation after 6 months, plus yearly accruals and birthday holiday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave; extended leave for birthing parents with ramp-back option to return part-time.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Access to platforms, development roadmap, and internal opportunities. Focus on continuous learning and feedback.
  • CULTURE: A team that breaks boundaries, supports each other, and values open communication and diverse perspectives.

Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn to glimpse life at Wellhub. Diversity, Equity, and Belonging: We are committed to a diverse, collaborative, and inclusive space.   • A Bachelor\'s or Master\'s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset, with the ability to take the lead in a small team and drive projects to completion by engaging with internal and external partners

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).

  • Adaptable and resilient in a high-growth startup/tech environment; a builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures; empathetic and clear in communication.
  • Integrity and accountability in handling confidential information; prior remote-work experience.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities in a leading digital asset company.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one; competitive PTO.

  • Elaborar narrativas visuais e relatórios executivos que contextualizem os dados e apoiem decisões pedagógicas e operacionais.
  • Apresentar resultados para públicos diversos, adaptando a linguagem conforme o contexto.
  • Apoiar a equipe de coordenação na consolidação de painéis institucionais e de clientes.
  • Apoiar processos formativos internos e externos sobre o uso e interpretação de dados.
  • Testar novas ferramentas e formatos de visualização.
  • Propor melhorias na coleta, automação e comunicação dos dados.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura de uso de dados nas equipes.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e qualificações essenciais:

  • Formação superior completa em Estatística, Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de dados, BI ou inteligência operacional.

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance — combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT. You will be customer-facing and the first line of support, owning the support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We are Mac-focused, you will troubleshoot, use the terminal, and manage enterprise macOS deployments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and own onboarding and offboarding experiences. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and improve knowledge bases. You will manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools and automate busywork. You will manage incidents and balance tickets with project work in agile environments.

What You Bring to Ledn:

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear writing for tickets, emails and Slack.
  • Proficiency in documenting solutions and automating routine tasks.
  • Experience with enterprise macOS management and SaaS tools listed above.
  • Networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); OSI model understanding.
  • Self-management and ability to scope projects and work across multiple teams; agile experience with Jira.

Nice to Haves:

  • Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line tooling; Jamf and Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment, values-driven, empathetic, and collaborative.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive rewards package and ownership in the company via equity; remote work worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Competitive PTO and a meaningful career with purpose.
  • Inclusive, diverse and equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests available during recruitment.

Equal Opportunity

Ledn is an equal opportunity employment organization and prides itself on inclusivity and the success that comes from diversity. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited resumes; applicants are asked to refrain from submitting agency resumes.

description:
Overview

Help us change lives

At Exact Sciences, we’re helping change how the world prevents, detects and guides treatment for cancer. We give patients and clinicians the clarity needed to make confident decisions when they matter most. Join our team to find a purpose-driven career, an inclusive culture, and robust benefits to support your life while you’re working to help others.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and oversee the operational aspects of a study including planning, start-up, enrollment and close out activities ensuring that deliverables are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with department procedures, applicable regulations and quality standards.
  • Prepare, review and implement study related plans and documents including project timelines, study protocols, informed consent forms (ICFs), recruitment plans, monitoring plans, study budgets, site contracts & budgets, vendor management plans and other essential clinical study documents.
  • Develop plans for systems and materials required to support the efficient execution of clinical studies and is responsible for effective management during the conduct of the study.
  • Develop, implement and maintain tools to manage, monitor and report on study health & operations, project timelines, and study finances to department management and other stakeholders.
  • Participate in study database development by reviewing and contributing to case report form (CRF) design, CRF completion guideline development, edit check & manual data review requirements, and participation in user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Oversee sample management activities including planning, sample handling, kit supply management, sample shipping, processing, and resulting.
  • Develop site recruitment plans and is responsible for the identification, selection, start-up and performance monitoring of clinical research sites.
  • Develop study budgets and is responsible for accurately forecasting and managing study expenses. Oversee site contracting and study budget management including facilitation of site contract and budget negotiations, invoice review and approval, accrual management and maintenance of budget tracking tools.
  • Oversee study and site management activities such as, training, data entry & query resolution, TMF maintenance, and ensure compliance with study plans such as the study protocol, monitoring plans, and recruitment plans.
  • Conduct monitoring activities as needed.
  • Ensure the smooth and efficient closure of studies through development of plans for completion of data verification & review, planning & facilitation of database lock activities, determination of site & IRB/EC readiness for closure, statistical analysis and clinical study report development.
  • Participate in the identification, qualification, selection and management of vendors providing support to clinical studies.
  • Provide oversight and support for assigned clinical operations study team members. Leads cross-functional team meetings, ensuring study goals and priorities are clear. Professionally interacts with investigators and site staff, vendors, key opinion leaders and consultants.
  • Ability to identify, mitigate and manage study risks. Responsible for maintaining ongoing study audit readiness and participates in internal or regulatory authority audits.
  • Provide guidance and support to less experienced team members. Fosters a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment, promoting continuous learning within the team.
  • Ability to provide oversight to multiple studies.
  • Participate or may facilitate department or project initiatives under the direction of department management or lead clinical trial manager.
  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality and teamwork.
  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.
  • Ability to work a designated schedule.
  • Ability to work on a mobile device, or in front of a computer screen and/or perform typing for approximately 90% of a typical working day.
  • Ability to work on a computer and phone simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel 20% of working time away from work location, may include overnight/weekend travel.
  • Ability to attend off-site meetings and conferences as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in the life sciences or field as outlined in the essential duties.
  • 5+ years of experience in clinical research.
  • 1+ year of experience leading project teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, analysis, close out and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Clinical monitoring experience including data review, query resolution, protocol deviation identification/tracking/trending, site initiation, site maintenance, and site closeout visits.
  • Experience writing, reviewing and editing protocols.
  • Knowledge of applicable quality standards (e.g. Good Clinical Practices (ICH/GCP), ISO 20916) and applicable local and national regulations governing clinical research.
  • Authorization to work in the US without sponsorship.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform the Essential Duties of the position with or without accommodation.
  • Experience providing oversight to external vendors (e.g. CRO, central labs, call centers, DCT providers).

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1+ year of clinical research experience with a sponsor company or CRO.
  • International study experience, IVDR, and GDPR implementation.
  • Working knowledge of the FDA submission process including, IDE, PMA and 510(k).
  • Experience as a study coordinator or clinical research associate.
  • Sample management system experience.

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing, the first line of support; own support, and provide an outstanding support experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.

  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets with project work; work in sprints and document progress in Jira (adhere to agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Have a passion for progress; adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company; equity through shared ownership.
  • Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (restrictions apply).
  • A career with purpose; we remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer; inclusive and diverse, with success from diversity.

Application and Environment

  • You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
  • Ledn is a globally distributed, remote-first team spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be adaptable to the evolving corporate infrastructure landscape and motivated to contribute to a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support and be the first line of support for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Proactively manage Mac endpoints and enterprise environments; procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding and offboarding experience.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and automation tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to IDP/SSO improvements (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Write clear help articles, automate repetitive tasks, and manage incidents to resolution.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets and participate in project work within agile sprints (Jira). Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools and onboarding processes (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows; knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Strong communication skills across all media; ability to convey ideas clearly and support others without frustration.
  • Excellent written communication for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Security-minded with knowledge of PGP and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); familiarity with OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and CLI workflows.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies company values.

Culture and Benefits

We seek leaders who are adaptable, resilient, and collaborative; a builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices; integrity and accountability in handling confidential information; and experience working in remote environments.

We offer a comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, including a competitive PTO package, stock ownership through equity, and remote-first policies allowing up to 180 days of remote work globally (subject to restrictions).

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. Applicants may reach out for accommodation requests during the recruitment process; requests will be handled confidentially.

Location and Recruitment Notes

Location: Petrolina, Pernambuco, Brazil. We are a remote-first organization and may contact qualified applicants due to high volume. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; unsolicited agency resumes are not accepted.

Nice to Have / Culture Fit

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who need assistance.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and able to work with high motivation, dependability, and experience in a fast-moving team. You will collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate communicates well, learns quickly, and seeks a supportive environment to grow IT skills.

This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • You will be customer-facing and provide first-line support via channels such as Slack and Jira.
  • You will be the go-to for troubleshooting, macOS enterprise integration, and end-user assistance.
  • You will procure and deliver technology equipment and own the onboarding and offboarding experiences for employees.
  • You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • You will own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • You will document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • You will manage incidents and issues to resolution and prioritize help desk tickets.
  • You will work on projects over sprints and document work in Jira, applying agile methods.
  • You will set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta.
  • Experience working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Strong communication skills across all media; ability to explain concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Excellent written communication for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise writing; culturally sensitive.
  • A genuine desire to provide a magical experience for others; strong security mindset and knowledge of PGP.
  • Fundamental networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and align work across multiple teams; strong organizational and task-management skills.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; prior hands-on use is helpful.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to streamline work.
  • Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We value leadership that thrives in startup or tech environments and embodies our values.
  • Ability to adapt, be resilient, and navigate ambiguity in a high-growth setting.
  • Builder’s mindset: eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner with empathy and clarity, capable of influencing across functions and cultures.
  • Integrity and accountability, especially in handling confidential information across diverse contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

title: Data Product Manager
description:
Data Product Manager

Location: REMOTE

Annual Compensation: $110,000.00 - $140,000.00 (DOE)

The Data Product Manager leads the definition, development, and lifecycle management of high-quality, reusable data products that drive value across business domains and the enterprise. Serving as a strategic link between business and technical teams, this role ensures data products are discoverable, well-governed, and interoperable from ideation through retirement.

You will oversee the creation and stewardship of enterprise reference data, including hospitals, helipads, airports, air ambulance bases, customers, health insurance plans, and payors. The ideal candidate brings proven expertise in research, data management, and governance, along with exceptional organizational and communication skills.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Coordination (20%)

  • Lead the development and management of GMR’s reference data processes, including stewardship, versioning, and golden record creation, in alignment with data lake and analytics strategies.
  • Define data quality metrics, standards, and SLAs.
  • Address data duplication, inconsistency, and fragmentation; develop and enforce data governance policies and operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT and security to standardize data access controls and support metadata management tool implementation (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
  • Assess data maturity, identify gaps, and implement improvements to ensure trusted, accessible, and well-managed data products.

Reference Data Research & Maintenance (60%)

  • Build and maintain comprehensive reference data for hospitals, customer profiles, transportation providers, airports, and fuel depots to support downstream workflows such as customer experience personalization and automation of eligibility and authorization processes.
  • Conduct ongoing research to maintain a current database of all U.S. air ambulance bases, including key operational details.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures for data research, maintenance, and change management to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Leverage enterprise data hubs and services for data storage, cataloging, maintenance, and sharing across key applications.

Data Integration & Synchronization (10%)

  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including Ambulance Communications, Clinical Informatics, Revenue Cycle, and IT Data Teams—to synchronize reference data across critical systems.

Data Analysis & Reporting (10%)

  • Develop reports and visualizations for reference data, market analysis, and air/ground decision-making.
  • Analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

Qualifications

Education & Industry Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, Computer Science, Information Systems, GIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years in data management roles, including database administration, data governance, master data management, or enterprise data strategy
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational databases, and data warehouse technologies, with a strong ability to analyze and validate data quality and lineage
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Domo)
  • Skilled in research, data collection, maintenance, and spatial analysis (GIS strongly preferred)
  • Background in healthcare, air and ground medical transport, or dispatch environments
  • Proven experience developing data products, managing master data, and working with metadata tools and data cataloging platforms
  • Proficient in maintaining reference databases and spreadsheets
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and governance tools (e.g., Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra) is a plus

Why Choose GMR?

Global Medical Response (GMR) and its family of solutions are dedicated to delivering compassionate, quality medical care, primarily in the areas of emergency and patient relocation services. Here you’ll embark on meaningful work that will make an impact on you and the customers we serve. This posting reflects the role and its requirements; no additional site-wide notices are included here.

EEO Statement

Global Medical Response and its family of companies are an Equal Opportunity Employer, which includes supporting veterans and providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with a disability.

Check out our careers site benefits page to learn more about our comprehensive benefit options, which include medical, vision, dental, 401k, disability, FSA, HSA, EAP, vacation and paid time off.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
